name: Cursed Crown
detailed_description:
Cursed Crown is an anime-style action RPG set in the medieval fantasy world of Alder, where exploration, combat, and relationships drive your adventure. Embark on a quest to uncover ancient ruins, battle fierce monsters, and forge meaningful relationships with intelligent, human-like AI characters to restore peace to a troubled land.

  • Dynamic Weapon and Skill Tree System: Each weapon you discover comes with a randomly generated set of elemental ability trees, offering endless possibilities and customization. Acquire powerful weapons by completing quests, exploring re-playable maps, and building deep connections with NPCs.

  • Relationship-Driven Gameplay: Engage with diverse AI-driven NPCs, each possessing distinct personalities, roles, and questlines. Develop relationships through conversations, errands, and story-driven quests. Strengthen these bonds to unlock exclusive rewards, including rare items, unique weapons, and cosmetic enhancements.

  • Rich Exploration and Combat: Venture into intricately designed ruins and immersive landscapes filled with challenging enemies and hidden secrets. Test your skills in fluid, action-packed combat enhanced by your personalized arsenal and abilities.

short_description: Cursed Crown is an anime-style action RPG featuring dynamic combat, deep exploration, and relationship-driven gameplay. Discover ancient ruins, wield weapons with customizable elemental skills, and forge bonds with lifelike AI characters to restore peace to the fantasy world of Alder.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-4670 (quad-core) / AMD® FX-Series™ FX-4350 (quad-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1050 (2 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ RX-460 (4 GB) / Intel® Arc™ A380 (6 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-7600 (quad-core) / AMD® Ryzen™ 3 2200G (quad-core)
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 (6 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ RX 580 (8 GB) / Intel® Arc™ A580 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 MB available space

content_descriptors.notes: There is very mild, cartoonish fantasy violence and there are animated, medieval style fights with weapons (without any gory blood).
